title: Ivo and the Orchard
author: Coral Iversen
blurb: Wendell Dravenmoor, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
